officialSources.observation: Notice dated 2023-10-20 announces a free visual cadastral-map query for any person, covering Hohhot urban districts, searchable using property-unit number or parcel code. It specifies a WeChat public-account channel and does not offer a vector API or download.

requests.observation: Official bureau notice reviewed; states open-to-anyone/no-fee/urban-district visual cadastral query, accessed through WeChat.
Live page review confirmed the only content link is a file-download attachment; no QR code, H5 link, or alternate public map URL appears in page content.

The official notice’s only file-download link was followed with a normal TLS-verified GET; it returned HTTP 200 text/plain (64 bytes) with a short failure response rather than a PDF. No attachment contents or parcel data were obtained.
